title: PV Power Site
description: A registered Solcast PV power site with full system specifications used with the advanced PV power model.

resource_id.description: Unique identifier assigned by Solcast when a site is registered.

name.description: User-defined name for the PV site (does not need to be unique).

latitude.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (north positive).

longitude.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (east positive).

tilt.description: Panel tilt angle in degrees from horizontal (0 = flat, 90 = vertical).

azimuth.description: Panel azimuth in degrees clockwise from north (0/360 = north, 90 = east, 180 = south, 270 = west).

install_date.description: Date the PV system was installed (YYYY-MM-DD).

ac_capacity.description: AC inverter output capacity in kilowatts (kW).

dc_capacity.description: DC array capacity in kilowatts (kW). May differ from capacity if clipping occurs.

loss_factor.description: System loss factor as a fraction (0–1). Accounts for wiring, soiling, degradation, and other losses. Typical values 0.75–0.95.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the site was registered in Solcast.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the site was last modified.
